The [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] known as the '''Dark Beast''' was native to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==History==
The only known sighting of the Dark Beast was in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], in the caves near [[Vur Tepe]] on Tython, where it attacked a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who was selecting a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] from the cave's crystal formations. It was killed by the Consular and its companion [[Qyzen Fess]], who were traveling through the cave to the Forge to craft their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
